# `csharp_space_before_dot`

Space before a dot.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder() .Append("Hello") .Append(", ") .ToString();
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").ToString();
    }
}
```
:::

::::

*Setting shown: `csharp_space_before_dot = true`*
